layman_headline: Market fear is high but the swing trade candidates today are weak — patience is the play.
layman_explanation: The crypto market is sitting in 'Fear' territory at 27/100 and Bitcoin dominance is high at 56.3%, which means money is flowing into Bitcoin rather than altcoins. The swing trade candidates this cycle are extremely poor: most are obscure micro-caps with no RSI data, no volume data, and no clear technical setups. The better-known coins like SOL and UNI are possible entries but don't yet have the oversold confirmation needed for a high-confidence trade. Sitting on the sidelines and waiting for a cleaner setup is the right call.
layman_action: Do nothing this cycle. Keep cash ready and watch for SOL to pull back toward $73-74 or UNI to show oversold RSI signals before committing capital.
expert_reasoning: None of the swing candidates present a compelling setup. BEAT dropped 45% in 7 days which looks like a mean-reversion candidate but has zero technical data (no RSI, no MACD, no volume comparison) and is 88% off ATH — too risky. CYS is up 140% in 7 days and clearly overextended. VELVET just dropped 28% in 24 hours with no discernible catalyst or floor. UNI is down 11% weekly and 92% off ATH — interesting but without RSI confirmation we can't verify it's truly oversold. SOL is the cleanest large-cap with positive momentum, but entering at current levels without a pullback offers inadequate risk/reward. The pending CPI report could create volatility that produces better entries. BTC dominance at 56.3% is hostile to alt positions. Our signal credibility data shows RSI is our most reliable indicator (71% win rate) and we have zero RSI readings on any candidate.
